title: Combining scEEG and PPG for reliable sleep staging
abstract: arXiv:2602.15042v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reliable sleep staging remains challenging for lightweight wearable devices such as single-channel electroencephalography (scEEG) or photoplethysmography (PPG). scEEG offers direct measurement of cortical activity and serves as the foundation for sleep staging, yet exhibits limited performance on light sleep stages. PPG provides a low-cost complement that captures autonomic signatures effective for detecting light sleep. However, prior PPG-based methods rely on full night recordings (8 - 10 hours) as input context, which is less practical to provide timely feedback for sleep intervention. In this work, we investigate scEEG-PPG fusion for 4-class sleep staging under short-window (30 s - 30 min) constraints. First, we evaluate the temporal context required for each modality, to better understand the relationship of sleep staging performance with respect to monitoring window. translated_title: 结合单通道脑电图（scEEG）与光电容积脉搏波（PPG）实现可靠的睡眠分期
translated_abstract: 对于单通道脑电图（scEEG）或光电容积脉搏波（PPG）等轻量级可穿戴设备而言，可靠的睡眠分期仍然具有挑战性。scEEG能够直接测量皮层活动，是睡眠分期的基础，但在浅睡阶段表现有限。PPG则提供了一种低成本的补充手段，能够捕捉对检测浅睡有效的自主神经特征。然而，以往基于PPG的方法依赖于整夜（8-10小时）记录作为输入上下文，这在为睡眠干预提供及时反馈方面不太实用。在本工作中，我们研究了在短时间窗（30秒至30分钟）约束下scEEG与PPG融合的四分类睡眠分期。首先，我们评估了每种模态所需的时间上下文，以更好地理解睡眠分期性能与监测窗口长度之间的关系。其次，我们研究了三种融合策略：评分级……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出在短时间窗（30秒至30分钟）约束下融合单通道脑电图与光电容积脉搏波，实现可靠的四分类睡眠分期，克服了以往PPG方法依赖整夜记录、难以提供及时睡眠干预反馈的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates fusing single-channel EEG with PPG under short-window (30 s–30 min) constraints for reliable 4-class sleep staging, overcoming prior PPG-based methods' reliance on full-night recordings for timely sleep intervention feedback.
